blue.label: Blue Family
blue.description: Institutional, educational, modern, and suitable for formal and private schools.

green.label: Green Family
green.description: Relaxing, balanced, and suggests growth, stability, and educational calm.

warm.label: Warm Family
warm.description: More accessible and human, suitable for Arabic identities or traditional schools.

purple.label: Purple Family
purple.description: Elegant and creative, ideal for royal, artistic, and technical schools.

classic.label: Classic Family
classic.description: Traditional and clean designs based on primary colors.

dark.label: Dark Family
dark.description: Professional dark mode for low-light work.

orange.label: Orange Family
orange.description: Vibrant and energetic, ideal for dynamic and active schools.

teal.label: Teal Family
teal.description: Modern and calm, blending professionalism with freshness, great for tech and science schools.

red.label: Red Family
red.description: Bold and powerful, conveying energy and passion, perfect for sports and arts schools.

indigo.label: Indigo Family
indigo.description: Deep and calm, reflecting knowledge and wisdom, suited for academic and research schools.

emerald.label: Emerald Family
emerald.description: Natural and refreshing, symbolizing growth and prosperity, beautiful for community schools.

amber.label: Amber Family
amber.description: Warm and welcoming, inspiring comfort and optimism, ideal for primary schools and kindergartens.
